quest.title: Search Chronicle: Audience with the Solitary King!
quest.description: Although his plan to make new buddies is not going well, Ranjit seems unconcerned. Indeed, he is already preparing for the next challenge...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x15, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

talks.objective: Go to The Court of the Millennial Pearl Seahorse

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: So we're here in the end...

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: When I became an adult, I finally understood why the Forest Watchers had made those faces they did...

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: *cough* But anyway, I gave it my best shot.

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: I also learned that you should never bring unprocessed Pyro Regisvine fruit near a Jadeplume Terrorshroom...

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: By the time I smelled something burning, it was already too late. Barely avoided drowning in the spores it poured forth.

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: It's easy to forget, sometimes, that Fungi are a completely different species from Shroomboars.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, speaking of which, they actually are a type of fungus, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: That's right, and they taste especially delicious in soups.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But anyway, let's get back to today's challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: Well, I haven't figured out what to cook ye... Oh! Right, uh, you mean the "negotiations." Sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: Perhaps you've heard the story of the two Fontemer Aberrant overlords? It speaks of how the Millennial Pearl Seahorse is described as being "proud" and "noble."

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: By contrast, the Emperor of Fire and Iron seems to be a fierce, cruel being, strong but brutal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And here Paimon thought you'd pick the tougher opponent. After all, wouldn't a stronger opponent make for a cooler story?

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: That is true, but the Emperor is a heavily-armored crab... While the other party's a seahorse that flies!

choices.text: I wonder, would you call a flying seahorse a Pegasus instead?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, is that the question we should be asking right now?

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Still, if I could only ride it, even once...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, sure then. Looks like you're sticking this one out to the end.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Well, we are here, aren't we? Surely we can't leave empty-handed? Anyway, let's head out once you're ready.

choices.text: I've got other things to handle. See you in a bit.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: No worries. I'll wait for you here.
